runtime_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph of an original adult paper conservator in a partially flooded historic library, lifting a water-damaged star atlas onto a mesh drying frame above mirror-like shallow water. A vertical chest-up viewpoint holds her face large in the upper half while her hands, the wet atlas, and the mesh frame occupy the lower third. Her makeup forms a restrained polished natural balance: sheer-to-light satin complexion correction leaves fine skin texture and natural tonal variation readable; softly groomed low-arch brows retain individual hairs; a neutral taupe wash is deepest at the upper lash line and diffuses through the crease; a slim interlash line ends in a very short tapered outer extension; lashes are clean and separated; a muted rose flush stays soft on the cheeks; muted rosy-coral lip color is strongest near the inner center, fades toward a softly diffused vermilion edge, and carries a low satin-balm sheen. Eye, cheek, and lip contrast remain mutually restrained so the complexion leads the hierarchy. An arched high window supplies broad diffused daylight as a soft neutral facial key while reflected water caustics stay below the jaw and on archive walls. The supplied portrait guides only this makeup placement, color distribution, and surface finish; the subject has an original facial identity. Avoid: fake-looking background, body distortion, 3D render look, cartoon style, plastic-looking skin, illustration look, unrealistic hands, excessive HDR, distorted fingers
